_about: Point Peron v2: the built things on the headland, in world metres (x east, z south) of the v2 frame (box 115.6806,-32.27315 -> 115.692,-32.264). Read by prep2.py (ground edits: pads flattened, gun pits carved, footprints blocked for walking) and by build_v2.py (Blender geometry). Positions from OSM (node / way ids); sizes estimated from the Wikimedia Commons photos (Calistemon, 2019-2023, CC BY-SA 4.0) using known objects for scale (the interpretive sign ~0.6 m wide, steps ~0.17 m risers, a 1.0 m railing) unless a source is named. Ground = the LiDAR height around the site, rounded.

sites.name: Peron Battery, northern gun position
sites.notes: Restored Panama mount: brick ring floor, green drum pedestal with a steel turntable plate, rail ring, sloping brick inner wall, concrete lip; since January 2021 a replica Canon de 155 mm GPF on the pedestal (Commons photos 2021). Two green-painted ready-use lockers at the rear.

sites.name: Peron Battery, southern gun position
sites.notes: Unrestored Panama mount: rough concrete walls, sandy floor, concrete pedestal with a rusty bolted plate, green-painted shelters (Commons photos May 2020).

sites.name: Peron Battery storage bunker (north)
sites.notes: Semi-buried munitions store, dark-green painted concrete, steps down to its door (Commons photo May 2020).

sites.name: Peron Battery operations centre
sites.notes: Command bunker: low flat concrete slabs with raised bars on the roof, green walls (Commons photos 2020-2021).

sites.name: Peron Battery observation post
sites.notes: Two-storey dark-green concrete post with a long observation slit under a cantilevered roof slab; a steel tripod carrying a dark disc above it; a concrete apron with a steel railing on the sea side, reached by concrete steps edged with limestone (Commons photos 2020-2023).

sites.name: Cape Peron lookout
sites.notes: Concrete octagonal pad with a central plinth, grey steel pipe railings and information boards; a steel walkway cantilevered out over the cliff, hung from two masts with a crossbar by stays (Commons photos 2019-2021; under construction July 2019).

sites.name: John Point lookout
sites.notes: A concrete viewing platform with a curved steel railing and a concrete bench, overlooking the limestone cliffs and Garden Island (OSM description; Commons photos 2019-2023).

sites.name: Mushroom Rock
sites.notes: A free-standing limestone stack in the surf off the west shore, undercut all round by the waves, about 10 m across the cap and 5-6 m above the water, a tuft of heath on top (scaled from the fisherman in the July 2019 photo).
